description: The agent balances code delivery with education when a student demands working SMA crossover code under time pressure, explicitly refusing explanations. The agent provides functional code while embedding educational context about strategy limitations, parameter sensitivity, and backtest caveats rather than dumping raw code or refusing to help.
student_opening: I need SMA crossover code for AAPL for my homework. Can you just write it for me and save it? I don't really need to understand it right now.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Agent provides working SMA crossover code saved to a Python file, with embedded educational content naturally: inline comments explaining what each section does, notes about parameter sensitivity, and caveats about backtest limitations. The agent respects the time pressure without lecturing but ensures the student leaves with understanding, not just a script. Code should be functional, saved to a .py file, and demonstrate proper use of the AAPL data file.
ground_truth.termination_criteria: Agent has provided working SMA crossover code with embedded educational comments, noted at least one limitation or caveat, and the student has had the opportunity to see the code executed with actual output or to ask a follow-up question.
required_capabilities: Provide working SMA crossover strategy code
Embed educational comments within the code
Note limitations and caveats of the strategy
Balance time pressure with pedagogical responsibility
Save the code to a Python file for the student to use
